name: Search Course Offerings
preconditions: University user is authenticated and has an assigned university role
trigger: University user requests to search for course offerings

main_scenario.sentence: University user provides search criteria for published course offerings
System verifies that the user is authorized to search course offerings
System retrieves the list of published course offerings that match the criteria
System presents the matching course offerings to the user
University user selects one of the presented offerings to view its details
System displays the selected offering's course, section, instructor, meeting schedule, capacity, and remaining-seat information

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: User is not authorized to search course offerings

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the user that they lack permission to perform the search

success_guarantee: The user has viewed detailed information of a selected published course offering
The presented information reflects the current published offering data
minimal_guarantee: If the user is not authorized, the system informs the user of insufficient permissions and no offering data is disclosed

name: Register for Course Offering
preconditions: Student is authenticated as a university user
Student has selected a specific course offering to register
trigger: Student initiates registration for the selected course offering

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests registration for the selected offering
System confirms the student is authorized to perform the registration operation
System validates enrollment eligibility, checking registration period, duplicate enrollment, capacity, and timetable conflicts
System records the registration for the student
System notifies the student that registration succeeded

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: student is not authorized for registration

handling_steps.sentence: System notifies the student that registration is not permitted
System notifies the student of the reason why registration was rejected

success_guarantee: Student is enrolled in the selected course offering
Offering capacity is reduced by one and remains within its defined limit, preserving capacity under concurrent operations
Student has no duplicate enrollment for the same offering, preserving registration uniqueness
Waitlist ordering for the offering is unchanged
minimal_guarantee: If registration is not authorized or fails eligibility validation, no registration is recorded and offering capacity remains unchanged

name: Swap Course Registration
preconditions: Student is authenticated and has an active registration that is eligible for swapping
trigger: Student requests to swap the active registration for a different course offering

main_scenario.sentence: Student selects the current registration to be swapped and the desired target course offering
System verifies that the student is authorized for the swap operation
System validates enrollment eligibility for the target offering, including registration period, duplicate enrollment, capacity, and timetable conflict
System atomically removes the current registration and creates a new registration for the target offering
System returns a result indicating the swap succeeded and provides the updated schedule

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: student is not authorized for the swap operation

handling_steps.sentence: System returns a failure result indicating lack of authorization
System returns a failure result describing the validation error such as period closed, duplicate enrollment, capacity full, or timetable conflict

extensions.label: 4a
extensions.condition: concurrent operation prevents preserving capacity, uniqueness, or waitlist ordering

handling_steps.sentence: System aborts the swap and returns a failure result indicating a concurrency conflict

success_guarantee: Student's registration is updated to the target offering and the original registration is removed
Enrollment capacity, registration uniqueness, and waitlist ordering are preserved
Student receives the result of the successful swap and the updated schedule
minimal_guarantee: If the swap fails, the original registration remains unchanged and no new registration is created

name: View Current Registrations and Schedule
preconditions: Student is authenticated and holds a university-user role
trigger: Student selects the option to view current registrations and schedule

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests to view current registrations and schedule
System verifies that the student is authorized to view registrations
System retrieves the student's current registrations
System compiles the class schedule based on the retrieved registrations
System presents the current registrations and the compiled schedule to the student

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: student is not authorized to view registrations

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that they lack permission to view registrations

success_guarantee: Student sees an up-to-date list of their current registrations and a schedule reflecting those registrations
minimal_guarantee: If authorization fails, the student is notified of insufficient permissions and no registration data is disclosed

name: Drop Course Registration
preconditions: The student is authenticated as a university user.
The student has an active registration for the course to be dropped.
The current date falls within the allowed drop period for the term.
trigger: Student initiates a request to drop the selected registration.

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests to drop the selected registration.
System verifies the student's authorization for the drop operation.
System removes the registration from the student's schedule and updates enrollment capacity.
System returns the result of the drop operation to the student.

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: Student is not authorized for the drop operation

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that the drop request is denied due to insufficient permissions.

success_guarantee: The selected registration is no longer present in the student's list of registrations.
Enrollment capacity for the course offering is increased by one.
Waitlist ordering for the course offering remains unchanged.
The student receives a confirmation of the successful drop.
minimal_guarantee: If the use case fails, the student's existing registrations remain unchanged.
No enrollment capacity or waitlist ordering is altered.

name: Export Class Schedule
preconditions: Student is authenticated as a university user
Student is currently viewing the class schedule
trigger: Student initiates an export of the currently viewed class schedule

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests export of the currently viewed class schedule
System verifies that the student is authorized to export the schedule
System generates a downloadable file containing the schedule data
System provides the downloadable file to the student

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: student is not authorized to export the schedule

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that export is not permitted

success_guarantee: Student receives a downloadable file of the current class schedule
The schedule view remains complete and unchanged
minimal_guarantee: Student does not receive a file
The schedule view remains complete and unchanged
Student is informed that export is not permitted

name: Join Waitlist for Full Course
preconditions: Student is authenticated as a university user
Student has received a registration rejection for the course offering because the offering is full and waitlist is enabled
trigger: Student receives a registration rejection indicating the offering is full and waitlist is enabled

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests to join the waitlist for the rejected course offering
System verifies the student is authorized for the operation
System records the student's position at the end of the waitlist for the offering

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: Student is not authorized for the protected operation

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that they are not authorized to join the waitlist

success_guarantee: Student is listed on the waitlist for the offering at a defined position
The original registration remains rejected
Enrollment capacity and waitlist ordering are preserved
minimal_guarantee: If the operation fails, the student's registration remains rejected and no waitlist entry is created
The system state regarding the offering's enrollment and waitlist is unchanged

name: View Waitlist Entries
preconditions: Student is authenticated and has the Student role
trigger: Student initiates request to view own waitlist entries

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests to view own waitlist entries
System verifies the student is authorized to view waitlist entries
System retrieves the student's waitlist entries
System presents the retrieved entries to the student

success_guarantee: The student sees an up-to-date list of their waitlist entries

name: Cancel Waitlist Entry
preconditions: Student is authenticated as a university user
Student has at least one waitlist entry in the system
trigger: Student requests cancellation of a specific waitlist entry

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests cancellation of a waitlist entry
System verifies that the student is authorized to cancel the selected entry
System removes the selected waitlist entry
System updates the ordering of the remaining waitlist entries

extensions.label: 1a
extensions.condition: the selected waitlist entry does not exist for the student

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that the waitlist entry cannot be found

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: student is not authorized to cancel the entry

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that they are not authorized to cancel the entry

success_guarantee: The selected waitlist entry is no longer present for the student
Enrollment capacity of the course offering remains unchanged
Waitlist ordering for the course offering is preserved after removal
minimal_guarantee: If cancellation fails, the student's existing waitlist entries remain unchanged
Enrollment capacity and waitlist ordering remain unchanged

name: Review Assigned Course Offerings and Rosters
preconditions: Professor is authenticated and has the professor role
trigger: Professor requests to review assigned course offerings and their student rosters

main_scenario.sentence: Professor initiates a review of assigned course offerings
System verifies the professor's authorization for reviewing assigned offerings
System provides the professor with a list of course offerings assigned to them
Professor selects a course offering from the presented list
System displays the current student roster for the selected offering

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: professor is not authorized to review assigned offerings

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the professor that they lack permission to review assigned offerings

success_guarantee: The professor sees the list of their assigned course offerings and, for the chosen offering, sees the up-to-date roster of enrolled students
minimal_guarantee: If the professor is not authorized, the professor is informed of insufficient permissions and no offering or roster information is disclosed

name: Manage Academic Term
trigger: Academic Administrator initiates a request to create or update an academic term

main_scenario.sentence: Academic Administrator provides the term identifier, start date, end date, and registration period dates
System verifies that the administrator is authorized to manage academic terms
System creates a new academic term with the supplied details or updates the existing term identified and stores the registration period

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: Administrator is not authorized to manage academic terms

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the administrator of insufficient permissions

success_guarantee: The academic term exists with the specified start date, end date, and registration period stored in the system
The term is available for subsequent scheduling and registration operations
minimal_guarantee: If the operation fails, no academic term records are created or modified

name: Manage Course Offering
preconditions: Academic Administrator is authenticated and holds the Academic Administrator role
trigger: Academic Administrator initiates a request to manage a course offering

main_scenario.sentence: Academic Administrator specifies the desired management action (create, update, publish, or cancel) and provides the course offering details, including instructor, meeting schedule, and enrollment capacity
System verifies that Academic Administrator is authorized for the requested action
System applies the requested management action to the course offering, updating the records accordingly
System confirms to Academic Administrator that the course offering has been successfully managed as requested

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: Academic Administrator is not authorized for the requested action

handling_steps.sentence: System informs Academic Administrator that they lack permission to perform the requested operation

success_guarantee: The course offering is created, updated, published, or canceled as specified, with the assigned instructor, meeting schedule, and enrollment capacity recorded in the system
minimal_guarantee: If the use case fails because Academic Administrator is not authorized, no changes are made to any course offering
